notes: Classic Era community-standard builds. Raiding is Shadow Bolt spam: DS/Ruin (sacrificed Succubus, +15% shadow damage) is the top damage build, SM/Ruin keeps a pet (Imp for Blood Pact) and is only slightly behind. Allocations validated against the Classic tree data.

builds.name: DS/Ruin — Demonic Sacrifice + Ruin (raid DPS)
builds.summary: The most popular Classic raiding build: sacrifice the Succubus for +15% Shadow damage, take Ruin for 200% crits, Improved Shadow Bolt for the 20% shadow vulnerability debuff, and Suppression/Improved Life Tap from Affliction for hit on Curses and mana.

core.why: Succubus sacrifice = +15% Shadow damage for 30 minutes.
Shadow Bolt crits deal 200% instead of 150%.
Crits apply +20% Shadow damage taken (4 charges) — helps every shadow caster.
-0.5s Shadow Bolt cast time.
+5% Destruction crit; prerequisite for Ruin.
+20% mana from Life Tap — your only mana source in a long fight.
+10% hit on Affliction spells (your assigned Curse and Corruption).
+15% Stamina; you Life Tap health into mana.
+20% range and -10% threat on Destruction spells.
Instant re-summon to sacrifice a Voidwalker for the shield in an emergency.

flex.why: Nothing in Demonology tiers 2-3 matters after the pet is sacrificed; these are the least useless fillers (mana/health while the pet is out).
Faster, cheaper re-summons to sacrifice again after a death.

notes: Shadow Bolt spam with your assigned Curse (usually Curse of Recklessness / Elements / Shadow). Corruption is added only if the raid allows the debuff slot.
Shadowburn is an execute/instant while moving; Curse of Doom on long fights where allowed.

builds.name: SM/Ruin — Shadow Mastery + Ruin (raid DPS)
builds.summary: Keeps the pet (Imp with Blood Pact for the tank group) and takes +10% Shadow damage from Shadow Mastery instead of the +15% from Demonic Sacrifice. Slightly less Shadow Bolt damage than DS/Ruin but better DoT damage (Improved Corruption, Nightfall) and much better for solo/PvP.

core.why: +10% Shadow damage without sacrificing the pet.
200% crits.
Shadow vulnerability debuff.
Instant Corruption — free damage between Shadow Bolts.
Corruption ticks proc an instant Shadow Bolt.
Cast time.
Mana.
Affliction hit.
Prerequisite for Shadow Mastery; small self-heal DoT.
+20% Affliction range.

flex.default: Improved Drain Soul 2 + Improved Curse of Weakness 2
flex.why: Four filler points are needed to reach 25 for Shadow Mastery; none of the options matter in a raid.
Only if you are assigned Curse of Agony; otherwise filler.

notes: At least one SM/Ruin lock per raid keeps an Imp for Blood Pact in the tank group.
Improved Firebolt is worth taking instead of Cataclysm if the Imp is out and attacking.

builds.name: Soul Link / Nightfall (PvP)
builds.summary: The durable PvP warlock: Soul Link splits 30% of damage taken to the pet, Fel Domination + Master Summoner re-summon instantly, Nightfall gives instant Shadow Bolts, Improved Corruption/Curse of Agony/Amplify Curse do the DoT work. Very hard to kill; damage is steady rather than bursty.

core.why: 30% of damage redirected to the pet, +3% damage.
Pet-dependent buffs: Voidwalker -10% physical damage taken, Succubus +10% damage, Felhunter resistances.
Instant re-summon after the pet dies.
Instant Shadow Bolt procs from Corruption.
Instant Corruption.
Big Curse of Agony/Exhaustion every 3 minutes.
+15% Stamina.
+20% pet melee damage; prerequisite for Master Demonologist.

alternatives: Improved Voidwalker 3 + Improved Health Funnel 2 + Improved Imp
flex.why: Improved Voidwalker is a fine swap when the Voidwalker is the PvP pet.
Hit on DoTs matters in PvP too, but Fel Concentration for Drain Life kiting is popular.

notes: Siphon Life is not reachable with Soul Link at 31 Demonology; SM/Ruin (above) is the higher-damage PvP alternative without Soul Link.

builds.name: Leveling — Affliction / Demonology (Voidwalker)
builds.summary: DoT-and-drain leveling with a Voidwalker tank: Improved Corruption first, Improved Drain Life and Fel Concentration for drain tanking, Siphon Life at 30 and Shadow Mastery at 39, then Demonology for pet durability and Unholy Power. Ends 30/21/0; respec to DS/Ruin or SM/Ruin for raiding.

core.why: Instant Corruption from 10 — DoT everything, let the Voidwalker tank.
Drain tanking keeps you full while the Voidwalker holds threat.
Another self-healing DoT at 30.
+10% Shadow damage at 39.
Instant Shadow Bolts.

flex.why: Two filler points on the way to 25 for Shadow Mastery.

notes: Multi-DoT 2-3 mobs while the Voidwalker tanks; Drain Life to refill; Life Tap between pulls.
Many players go Demonology first (Demonic Embrace, Improved Voidwalker) for an easier 10-30; this order gets Siphon Life earlier.
